plate.title: B13 · Four-colour interlocking gardens
plate.description: The four actual quarter-related serif-I images are four stable colour families. Ornament follows each I's long crossbar and broad end caps, with visible inner veins and curled cap fans. Larger bright flowers punctuate selected interlocks; the complete four-image source remains the placement construction.

constructionNotes: The four actual quarter-related serif-I images are four stable colour families.
